const test=require('node:test'),assert=require('node:assert/strict'),fs=require('node:fs'),path=require('node:path'),crypto=require('node:crypto');
const R=path.join(__dirname,'..'),D=path.join(__dirname,'fixtures/ticker-lookup/incoming-chart'),hash=s=>crypto.createHash('sha256').update(s).digest('hex'),plan=require(path.join(D,'transition.json')),helper=require('./helpers/incoming-buyback-tag-preservation.cjs');
test('peer insertion leaves every other byte of the complete chart HTML unchanged',()=>{const raw=fs.readFileSync(path.join(R,'chart.html'),'utf8');assert.equal(helper.normalize(raw),fs.readFileSync(path.join(D,'chart-before.html.txt'),'utf8'));assert.equal(hash(fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname,'fixtures/buyback-pane/predecessor.js.txt'))),plan.latest_peer_script_sha256);});
test('earlier layout preservation helper remains byte-identical',()=>{const old=fs.readFileSync(path.join(D,'layout-helper-before.cjs.txt'),'utf8'),current=fs.readFileSync(path.join(R,'tests/helpers/chart-readout-layout-preservation.cjs'),'utf8');assert.equal(current,old);});
test('peer insertion proof refuses other source changes and duplicate tags',()=>{const raw=fs.readFileSync(path.join(R,'chart.html'),'utf8');assert.throws(()=>helper.normalize(raw.replace('id="host"','id="changed"')));assert.throws(()=>helper.normalize(raw+plan.added));});
